dharanas.do: watch ūrdhva-prāṇa heart→12-end and jīva return; fill both with awareness
nirvikalpa attention in the central channel; breath's coarse flow drops
inhale to heart, retain briefly, exhale; non-conceptual calm shines
Śakti rising from the root as calming lightning; Bhairava at subsidence
lightning-like ascent through the centres; mahodaya at the end
central channel thin as a lotus stalk, interior; deva shines
close all head openings by hand; supreme fixation in the middle
press/agitate eyeballs till tremor ceases; dissolve into That
imagine the skin-partition wall-less; supportless meditation
gaze introverted, thought dissolved in hṛd-ākāśa
fix mind there from all sides
kālāgni in the toe consuming body/universe to ash
rest attention where ingress ends and egress begins
tickling laughter burst; uncontainable laugh reveals tattva
recollect delight even absent; own bliss proclaimed
merge in ānanda-continuum; mind dissolved becomes That
soft seat, rest on sphija; pūrṇā mati
seated, ardha-kuñcita arms stabilized; mind quiets
tongue centred, mouth widened inward; dissolve in śānta
house the whole ākāśa inside the skull; enter tejas
softly closed eyes on blackness; become That
at the moment of sense-contact, attend; ātman shines there
prolong any savisarga letter (kaḥ, khaḥ…); touch Brahman
pierce any limb with a sharp point; one-pointed Bhairava-gati
contract ears, close adhodvāra, hear inner unstruck resonance
catch beginning and end of a sneeze; Brahman-proximity
